name: Agent editor Context tab: browse project documents and attach two
description: Opens the General Reviewer from /agents, switches to its Context tab, confirms the seeded project documents are listed, attaches security-baseline.md then public-api.md, and confirms the '2 of 5 attached' badge, then reloads the agents list and re-opens the tab to confirm the attachments persisted. Drag-reordering (AC-16) is NOT driven here — agent-browser has no verified HTML5 drag command (plan OQ-2); order persistence is covered by the server integration test and the reorderAttached unit test. Mutates the seeded DB (attachments persist), so flow 12 relies on public-api.md being attached to General Reviewer here. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB. Covers AC-13, AC-16 (partial).
